detailed_description: The YAML/JSON Converter provides two side-by-side text areas for converting simple YAML to formatted JSON and JSON back to YAML in the browser. Paste YAML on the left and click the JSON button, or paste JSON on the right and click the YAML button. The tool shows a basic validation error when the input cannot be parsed and includes copy buttons for both text areas. It is useful for quick configuration snippets and small structured examples, but complex YAML features may not round-trip exactly.
usage_steps: Paste YAML into the YAML text area or JSON into the JSON text area.
Click the arrow button for the conversion direction you need.
Review the converted output in the opposite text area.
If an error appears, fix the YAML or JSON syntax and try again.
Use the copy button beside either text area to copy the current content.
usage_examples: Convert a small YAML configuration snippet into formatted JSON.
Turn a JSON example object into YAML for documentation.
Check whether a simple YAML sample parses before adding it to a config file.
Copy converted YAML or JSON into a test fixture or technical note.
